description: Find new-high, VCP, and breakout stocks with strong fundamentals and liquidity. Variant focus: watchlist creation; timeframe: today; response style: debug trace.
input_patterns: stocks creating new highs or VCP or breakouts with good fundamentals
VCP breakout stocks for TradingView

review.rationale: Static audit and test findings drive deterministic review.

sql_templates.template_sql:
WITH latest_eod AS (
                SELECT * FROM market.equity_eod
                WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
                AND series = 'EQ'
            ),
            latest_snapshots AS (
                SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots
                WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
                AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
                AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
            ),
            latest_vcp AS (
                SELECT * FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
                WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
                ORDER BY vcp_score DESC, rank ASC
                LIMIT 50
            )
            SELECT eod.symbol, eod.close, snaps.stage, snaps.trading_signal, vcp.vcp_score
            FROM latest_eod eod
            JOIN latest_snapshots snaps ON eod.symbol = snaps.symbol
            JOIN latest_vcp vcp ON eod.symbol = vcp.symbol
            WHERE eod.close > eod.week52_high * 0.95
            ORDER BY vcp.vcp_score DESC;

synthesis_guidance: ['Provide observations on VCP and breakout patterns.', 'Discuss fundamental scores and their implications.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0604
validation_rules: Check SQL syntax and validity against provided schema.
Ensure query outputs match expected contract.

sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_analysis
sql_templates.template:
SELECT b.sector, b.breadth_signal, ma.stage2_pct, s.stage, s.symbol, s.company_name, s.trading_signal, e.close 
FROM breadth.sector_daily b 
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON b.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON b.sector = s.sector 
JOIN market.equity_eod e ON s.symbol = e.symbol 
WHERE b.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily) 
AND s.stage = 'STAGE_2' 
AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') 
AND e.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod) 
ORDER BY ma.stage2_pct DESC, b.breadth_signal DESC 
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Emphasize risk-first review and provide debug traces for better insights.', 'Highlight sectors with high stage 2 participation and positive breadth signals.']
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 0615
